data.name: Blinding Strike
data.description: You can create a flash of sunlight in the eyes of one of your opponents. The target is blinded for 1 round. If it succeeds at a Reflex saving throw, it's instead dazzled for 1 round. Creatures with light blindness or light sensitivity take a -4 penalty on this saving throw. This is a light effect. Sightless creatures are unaffected by this ability.
